xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4942: Agent MCP and bots (W-LINK1): link_machine: ask the operator to link a machine

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-LINK1): link_machine: ask the operator to link a machine
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: An agent told to work on a machine that is not linked has no safe way to get it linked. Asking in chat would put a pairing link (with its one-time odp_ code) into the agent's transcript. W-SEC1 (PAN-4941) built an in-memory agent request store, operator routes and a Decisions card for secrets only; the store already names a machine-link kind, but no route creates one, the list route drops the hint, the decline route refuses non-secret requests, and the frontend drops every non-secret row.
narratives.Proposal: Add the machine-link kind end to end, lowered in .pan/drafts/PAN-4942.md: (1) a createMachineLink store creator with a 24-hour expiry, same-hint dedupe and a result that can carry { environmentId, label }; (2) agent self routes POST /api/self/machine-link-requests (tell) and GET /api/self/machine-link-requests/:id/wait (read:state), each wait answering only its own kind; (3) a root-only POST /api/agent-requests/:id/linked that finds the active link by environment id in the link store and settles the request linked with the stored label, plus a decline route that takes either kind and a list row that carries the hint; (4) agent-only MCP tools link_machine and link_machine_wait; (5) the Anywhere dialog store carries an agentRequestId; (6) a 'Machine link requested' blocking card whose Link a machine… button opens the existing dialog with the request id and whose Dismiss declines; (7) LinkMachineDialog posts the resolve after a successful link; (8) docs in configuration/mcp.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md, configuration/linked-machines.mdx and the codebase map.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Resolving a pending request from a link made outside the card's dialog (pan machines link, the Machines panel, the SSH or Fly dialogs, the command palette).
- Picking an already-linked machine from the card.
- Answering a machine-link request from a phone, a linked machine's browser, a bot or any registry token.
- Adding delegate_task or changing the W-INJ4 instruction block text.
- Persisting agent requests across a dashboard restart.
- Any agent-visible field that carries the pairing link, the odp_ code or a body-supplied label.
- A new /dismiss route (Dismiss uses the existing decline route).

autoDecisions.summary: Add createMachineLink next to createSecret; both use one private insert helper.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps expiry, ids and waiters in one place; the epic gave no creator and the shipped store has only createSecret.

autoDecisions.summary: Dedupe a machine-link ask on the same owner and the same trimmed, case-insensitive hint; a different hint makes a new request; both kinds share the 20-request limit.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors W-SEC1's same-name rule; an agent can need two machines.
The epic fixes 24 h, and linking needs the operator at the other machine.

autoDecisions.summary: Widen AgentRequestView.result and settle's result to { file?, machine?: { environmentId, label } }.
autoDecisions.rationale: One result shape for both kinds; the wait route reads it.

autoDecisions.summary: Each wait route answers 404 unknown-request at once for a request of the other kind, including the secret wait.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shared store now holds two kinds; a wrong-kind wait must not block 50 s and answer a foreign status.

autoDecisions.summary: The /linked body is read for environmentId only; the label comes from the active link record found with listLinks() by environmentId and revokedAt === null.
autoDecisions.rationale: getLink also matches ids and labels and returns revoked links; the client must not choose the label the agent sees.

autoDecisions.summary: /linked settles expired and answers 409 agent-stopped when the agent holds no active agent token.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parity with the secret route; the machine stays linked.

autoDecisions.summary: Dismiss uses the existing /decline route, widened to both kinds with a kind-aware activity message.
autoDecisions.rationale: No new route surface; declined is already a status the wait answers.

autoDecisions.summary: AgentRequestCard branches on kind with a MachineLinkRequestBody function in the same file; Decision.agentRequest becomes a discriminated union.
autoDecisions.rationale: DecisionsPanel already renders AgentRequestCard for any agentRequest decision; one card file stays small.
The agent is parked in link_machine_wait.

autoDecisions.summary: The Anywhere dialog store holds agentRequestId; openDialog sets it from opts and close clears it.
autoDecisions.rationale: A later palette open must never resolve an old request.

autoDecisions.summary: LinkMachineDialog resolves after a successful link, shows an info toast on agent-stopped and an error toast on other failures, invalidates ['agent-requests'] and always closes.
autoDecisions.rationale: A resolve failure must never undo or hide a successful link.

autoDecisions.summary: Only the card's dialog resolves a request; other link paths leave it pending until Dismiss or 24 h.
autoDecisions.rationale: Auto-matching links to requests is out of scope; the tool description tells the agent the operator must use the card.

autoDecisions.summary: link_machine_wait tells the agent to pass the label as machine to start_worker or start_conversation, not delegate_task.
Hints are trimmed, 1 to 200 characters, with no control characters, else 400 bad-hint.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic fixes 1..200; control characters have no place in a card line.

autoDecisions.summary: Add AgentRequestCard.test.tsx and the new LinkMachineDialog.test.tsx to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend tests; W-SEC1 shipped the card test without a row.

metadata.sizeJustification: This issue is already one decomposed child (W-LINK1) of epic PAN-4927 and one vertical feature: an agent asks, the operator links through the existing dialog, the agent learns the label. The projected-surface count reaches 8 'subsystems' and 26 files only because each root-level doc file (configuration/mcp.mdx, configuration/linked-machines.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md, the epic PRD, the codebase map, scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt) counts as its own subsystem; the code itself spans src/dashboard, src/lib and tests/unit. Splitting the server half from the card and dialog would ship a tool no operator can answer, or a card for requests no agent can make.
